analyst.summary: Dynamatic Technologies makes hydraulic gear pumps, turbochargers and aerospace components, with a leading share of India's tractor hydraulics market. Revenue growth has picked up over the last year, but profitability is thin and inconsistent quarter to quarter, and return on equity is low (around 7-8%). At the current price the stock trades at a very rich valuation - well above what the underlying earnings and returns currently justify - so we rate it a Sell on valuation grounds rather than any balance-sheet or governance concern.
